about: Proof manifest (protocol fix round, 2026-11-17). The gate runs every proof under "run" in build-and-test at every tier via scripts/run-proofs.py - registering a proof is adding its name here, never editing checks.yml. A proof whose subject has left the app moves to "retired" with the reason recorded; scripts/check-proof-coverage.py fails the build if any file in tests/proof/ is in neither list, if a listed name does not exist, or if a retired entry carries no reason. Proof files never classify a round's tier (scripts/select-tier.py treats tests/proof/** as ride-along, like drive files).
